messages.subject: [FAQ] checklist before use 'ProgenesistoMSstatsFormat' in v3.7.3 for Progenesis output
messages.subject_clean: [FAQ] checklist before use 'ProgenesistoMSstatsFormat' in v3.7.3 for Progenesis output
messages.body_plain:
Before using 'ProgenesistoMSstatsFormat', please check the list below.

1. Read User manual of v 3.7.3, from page 35.
2. Prepare annotation file as described in the manual. (Annotate Run, Condition, BioReplicate information)
3. Check the order of columns of quantified peak abundance :   'Normalized abundance' columns, then 'Raw abundance' columns, then 'Spectral counts' columns at the end, as shown from page 35-37 in manual.
4. When you read the output of Progenesis with read.csv function, don't forget to add 'stringsAsFactor=FALSE' option. Please use as below.
raw <- read.csv('progenesis_output.csv', stringsAsFactors=FALSE)

messages.subject: MaxQtoMSstatsFormat edge case problem
messages.body_plain:
Hi!

When using the MaxQtoMSstatsFormat function I encountered the following error:

> > raw <- MSstats::MaxQtoMSstatsFormat(evidence=infile, annotation = annot, proteinGroups)
> + Contaminant, + Reverse, + Only.identified.by.site, proteins are removed.
> Peptides including M in the sequence are removed.
> Error in aggregate.data.frame(mf[1L], mf[-1L], FUN = FUN, ...) :
>   no rows to aggregate

I presumably identified the problem as an incorrectly handled edge case in the filtering for the case in which no ProteinGroup is "Only identified by site".
A fix for this at multiple places in the MaxQtoMSstatsFormat function can be found at https://github.com/jan-glx/MSstats/commit/70b1ed621ccc95bbd939b4355d6f8de9b003e153  .
Might be related to https://groups.google.com/forum/#!searchin/msstats/no$20rows$20to$20aggregate%7Csort:relevance/msstats/fP_Mbks32gw/ualsWXGPjb4J

all the best,
Jan

messages.subject: Re: Please keep only one intensity of listed features among multiple runs from one sample.
messages.subject_clean: Please keep only one intensity of listed features among multiple runs from one sample.
messages.body_plain:
Dear Chris,

This type of issue can be happened in most of spectral processing tools except Skyline. From MSstats v3.7.3, it can be solved if you use the converter functions in MSstats for output from Skyline, Spectronaut, Progenesis, MaxQuant, Proteome Discoverer. (Please check MSstats manual from msstats.org <http://msstats.org>) If you used other tool, please make sure that MSstats needs one row with one intensity value for one feature (PSM for DDA, transition level for SRM, fragmentation for DIA) and one MS run. This error message means there are more than one rows for one feature and one MS run.

If you have issue with converter functions, please share your data with us.

Hope to help.

Sincerely,
- Meena
